regime_context: Gold Miners dominate as the sole leading theme with near-perfect trend durability (0.94) and full breadth, but leadership is narrowing (45% of themes eligible, no one-narrative dominance). The absolute-trend gate historically did not help manage drawdowns in this market (gate_helps=false), and momentum ranks are a focus lens with zero validated forward edge, making this a display-only read. The macro backdrop is dominated by AI-tech and geopolitics headlines with high unscheduled news risk (94%). emerging_watch: Watch for Industrial Metals (cn_metals) to sustainably challenge Gold Miners for top leadership. Condition: if cn_metals score exceeds cn_gold score for 5 consecutive trading days, it would signal a potential confirmed rotation out of the gold theme.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners leads with the strongest trend health (highest durability_bar 0.94, full breadth 1.0, trend Hurst tag) and no crowding. While the detector's trend-gate edge is absent historically on this market, the theme's internal cohesion supports continuation. Unscorable nature (no ETF proxy) introduces execution uncertainty, so this lean is directional only.
theses.dissent: Gold miners may be highly correlated to global gold prices; a strengthening USD or recovery in risk appetite could reverse the trend. Without a liquid proxy, tracking and implementation are imprecise.

falsifier.text: Gold Miners score falls below Industrial Metals score and stays there for 5 consecutive trading days.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals ranks 2nd with strong trend health (durability_bar 0.87, trend tag, breadth 0.92) and is not crowded. The theme belongs to the same cyclical resource group as the leader and has a scorable ETF proxy (512400.SS). However, the disappearance of the absolute-trend gate edge in this market means the trend-following discipline is experimental here, so any overweight should be sized conservatively.
theses.dissent: Industrial cycles can turn abruptly if global growth expectations sour; the widely documented mean-reverting character of Chinese equities could whipsaw trend-followers.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS closes below its 20-day moving average and lags the CSI 300 by more than 3% over a 10-day rolling window.
